The *Dhammavinayapaṭicchannāpaṭicchannapañha* ("On Secret Doctrine", Mil 5.4.2) is a section of the late canonical/post-canonical dialogue *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. It examines the question of whether the Dhamma and Vinaya are taught openly or kept concealed, a theme associated with the canonical *Paṭicchannasutta* (AN 3.131) as well as Vinaya texts such as the *Uposathakkhandhaka* (Kd 2) and the *Ekuttarikanaya* of the *Parivāra* (Pvr 7) [SuttaCentral]. Two modern translations into two languages are cataloged on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
